text:
Sam (PM): quick design check: compact scorecard mode and approve microcopy. want to avoid modal fatigue but keep clarity. thoughts?
Lila (Design): compact mode should surface per-test quick actions, but keep them subtle. thinking an ellipsis menu with 'Approve' + 'View diff' rather than full primary buttons.
Nora (Product): Users get confused whether 'Approve' updates baseline or just marks reviewed. copy needs to be explicit: 'Approve and update baseline' vs 'Mark reviewed'.
Dev (Eng): backend does two things: mark reviewed (ui-only flag) or approve (baseline update job). both endpoints exist. we can wire verbs to disambiguate.
Priya (A11y): Important: include accessible names for each action, e.g., aria-label="Approve test 12 — updates baseline". Also keyboard access must be within compact list focus order.
Lila (Design): Good. For compact, inline approve icon (check) + confirmation toast rather than blocking modal. modal only for bulk-approve.
Sam (PM): I worry about accidental baseline updates in compact mode. maybe require a two-step: click icon shows inline confirm button 'Confirm' within the row. short and fast but prevents fat-finger errors.
Dev (Eng): two-step inline confirm is cheap to implement. we'll show a small ephemeral confirm, focus it, and if user hits Esc it cancels. add data-qa attributes: data-qa=compact-approve, data-qa=compact-approve-confirm.
Priya (A11y): when inline confirm appears, move focus into it and announce: "Confirm baseline update for Test 12" via aria-live polite. After success, announce "Test 12 approved."
Nora (Product): modal copy for bulk: "Approving will update baselines for X tests. This cannot be undone. We recommend running diffs before approving." include 'Run diffs' link and 'Undo' info (we do have an undo window of 10 minutes).
Lila (Design): UI hint: show scope label near bulk button: small text "Approving visible tests (20)" so users remember filters.
Sam (PM): keyboard shortcuts — single test approve = 'a' when row focused, bulk = 'Shift+A' with confirmation. show tooltip on hover with shortcut.
Dev (Eng): implementable. but watch disagreements between browser-level shortcuts (Cmd+A). we'll scope to the list when it has focus and show small help bubble with exact target.
Priya (A11y): avoid ambiguous single-letter shortcuts unless shown and discoverable. ensure they are disabled when an input is focused. also ship an alternative: longpress Enter = confirm.
Lila (Design): microcopy tweak: inline confirm button text shouldn't be 'Yes' — use 'Approve & update baseline' (long but clear) or shorthand 'Approve & update'. prefer shorter but unambiguous. 4.5:1 contrast on buttons.
Nora (Product): agree on shorter: 'Approve & update' — also add tooltip with full explanation.
Dev (Eng): telemetry note: emit event for approve type (inline vs bulk vs modal) so product can see accidental patterns.
ci-bot: baseline-update job for run 311 queued — ETA ~25s.
Priya (A11y): quick a11y nit: toasts must be dismissible and not steal focus. use role=status for success toasts and avoid keyboard trap.
Sam (PM): next steps: Lila to update Figma compact mocks + inline confirm states; Nora to draft modal + tooltip copy; Dev to add data-qa and keyboard handlers; Priya to validate SR announcements. target: design review Thurs.
Lila (Design): will upload mock: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/compact-scorecard-approve
Nora (Product): I'll paste copy drafts in figma comments.
Dev (Eng): will stub handlers in feature branch and add e2e tests referencing data-qa.
Priya (A11y): I'll run a screen-reader pass after mocks are updated and comment.
Sam (PM): thanks — short follow-up in next standup.
